phase6h.production_dependencies: Collect added-file FIM at the exact WordPress Docker volume path and native URL telemetry for uploads requests.

investigative_context_only: Session/process identity and actor attribution are not query requirements.
data.method, data.status, data.request, data.dstip; source IP except WEB-001. HTTP 200 is not a predicate.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Agent-only joins and attribution
phase6h_limitations.finding: Agent/time association does not establish actor identity or causal activity. SSH-001 and WEB-001 also join source IP; PRIV and MAL have stage joins.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: User/session/process continuity
phase6h_limitations.finding: Published queries omit session/process joins; PRIV correlates selected usernames, not session/process identity.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Source IP and shared proxies
phase6h_limitations.finding: SSH-001/WEB-001 enforce equal source strings; strings do not establish individual actors behind a shared address. Proxy efficacy itself remains untested.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Command/path/service relationships
phase6h_limitations.finding: Missing interstage relationships permit unrelated activity. MAL joins paths and PRIV selected users; other omitted links remain omitted.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Scheduled versus realtime FIM
phase6h_limitations.finding: SSH-003 and MAL require exact realtime; several other FIM rules have no mode restriction.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Case-sensitive exact predicates
phase6h_limitations.finding: Case-sensitive IDs, literals, joins and wildcard paths constrain observed coverage.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Broad wildcard and substring matches
phase6h_limitations.finding: Wildcards span nested paths and empty components; command substrings do not prove executed binaries.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Empty-string joins and wildcard matches
phase6h_limitations.finding: Non-null checks do not establish nonempty or well-formed values; empty matching source strings and wildcard components can match.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Missing/null predicate and join fields
phase6h_limitations.finding: Required fields/joins reject tested missing/null values. This does not cover missing timestamps or categories.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Equal-timestamp ordering
phase6h_limitations.finding: 18 unique equal/partial timestamp investigations remain INCONCLUSIVE. Two Phase 6A boundary and two optional-username investigations also remain historically INCONCLUSIVE, totaling 22. Recovery repeats one tie identity without resolving it.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: PRIV optional username
phase6h_limitations.finding: Absent/null final username does not wildcard-match preceding populated username; no intended detection coverage claimed.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: MAL exclusion isolation
phase6h_limitations.finding: No-sequence observations confound exclusion with path join or first-stage directory predicate. Isolated scalar exclusion effectiveness unproven.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Missing/null timestamps and categories
phase6h_limitations.finding: Different category values tested for some rules; missing/null ordering/category fields not covered.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Multivalued fields
phase6h_limitations.finding: Scalar fixture evidence does not establish multivalued predicate/join behaviour.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Competing sequences
phase6h_limitations.finding: One candidate chain per partition; selection under competing events not established.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Ingestion delay and arrival ordering
phase6h_limitations.finding: Event timestamp reversals tested; delayed ingestion and scheduling interactions not established.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Scheduling and deduplication
phase6h_limitations.finding: No scheduler/overlap/state/deduplication evidence.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Native Wazuh mappings and field population
phase6h_limitations.finding: Synthetic strict mappings cannot establish native alert field types, keyword multifields, normalization or population.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Production scale and detection efficacy
phase6h_limitations.finding: No representative load, benign baseline, precision/recall or operational efficacy evidence.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.

phase6h_limitations.subject: Stage-specific join mismatch for rules without stage joins
phase6h_limitations.finding: Only PRIV and MAL have stage-specific joins; other rules use their stated global joins.
phase6h_limitations.inspection_class: Mapping can check structure only; representative events and/or later laboratory tests required.
